## Pull Request Checklist

- [ ] **Tests**: Relevant unit and integration tests added or updated; entire suite passes (`flutter test`).
- [ ] **Static Analysis**: Code is formatted and passes analyzer checks without warnings (`flutter analyze`).
- [ ] **API Documentation**: Public declarations (providers, entities, failures) include comprehensive `///` doc comments.
- [ ] **Documentation Accuracy**: Architectural, API reference, and troubleshooting docs are updated to match implementation reality.
- [ ] **Style & Tone**: Documentation, comments, and commit messages adhere to `AGENTS.md` style (technical, precise, zero emojis).
- [ ] **Payload Safeguards**: No heavy assets, machine learning checkpoints, or secrets staged or committed.
